description: This PHP class 'MenuService' provides functionality for managing and retrieving menu items in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It handles caching, enabling/disabling menu items, and generating menu structures for UI display, integrating with permissions and configurations.

classes.name: MenuService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing menu items, including enabling/disabling, caching, retrieving menu structures, and integrating permissions and configurations within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getMenuDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the MenuDao instance used for database interactions related to menu items.

methods.name: getScreenPermissionService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ScreenPermissionService instance used for permission checks.

methods.name: enableModuleMenuItems
methods.description: Enables menu items for a specific module by name and optional list of menu titles, clearing relevant caches.

methods.name: invalidateCachedMenuItems
methods.description: Clears cached menu data from user attributes to force refresh.

methods.name: getDetailedSidePanelMenuItemsAlongWithCache
methods.description: Retrieves detailed side panel menu items, using cache to avoid repeated database queries.

methods.name: getTopMenuItemsAlongWithCache
methods.description: Retrieves top menu items associated with a side panel item, with cache support.

methods.name: generateCacheKeyForTopMenuItem
methods.description: Generates a cache key string for top menu items associated with a specific side panel item.

methods.name: getMenuItems
methods.description: Constructs and returns the menu structure based on current context, configuration, permissions, and user interface URL.

methods.name: getMenuItemChainForMenuItem
methods.description: Returns the parent chain of a specific menu item.

methods.name: isActiveSidePanelMenuItem
methods.description: Determines if a side panel menu item is active based on current module/screen or configurator mappings.

methods.name: isActiveTopMenuItem
methods.description: Checks if a top menu item is active based on current module/screen or configurator mappings.

methods.name: normalizeMenuItem
methods.description: Prepares a menu item array with URL, title, and active state for UI rendering.

methods.name: normalizeTopMenuItem
methods.description: Constructs a nested top menu item array with children, handling active state and filtering.
